';document.body.appendChild(s.div);const {V86}=await ctx.utils.import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/v86@0.5.462/build/libv86.mjs');const disk=new Uint8Array(1474560);disk.set(new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(ctx.assets['boot.bin'])).arrayBuffer()));s.serial='';s.emulator=new V86({wasm_path:ctx.assets['v86.wasm'],memory_size:16*1024*1024,vga_memory_size:2*1024*1024,screen_container:s.div,bios:{url:ctx.assets['seabios.bin']},vga_bios:{url:ctx.assets['vgabios.bin']},fda:{buffer:disk.buffer},autostart:true,disable_keyboard:true,disable_mouse:true,disable_speaker:true});s.emulator.add_listener('serial0-output-byte',b=>{s.serial+=String.fromCharCode(b);});for(let n=0;n<150;n++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));s.canvas=s.div.querySelector('canvas');if(s.serial.includes('BOOT OK')&&s.canvas?.width===320)break;}if(!s.serial.includes('BOOT OK')||s.canvas.width!==320)throw Error('x86 guest failed to boot into VGA: '+s.serial);s.running=true;
